description: Source code for the SessionServerAppManager class, which manages session server applications including launching, preloading, state changes, and health checks within the Rialto server manager component.

classes.name: SessionServerAppManager
classes.description: Manages session server applications, including launching, preloading, configuration, state management, and health checks.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session server app manager with dependencies.

methods.name: ~SessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Destructor that shuts down all session servers and cleans up resources.

methods.name: preloadSessionServers
methods.description: Preloads a specified number of session servers.

methods.name: initiateApplication
methods.description: Initiates a session server application with a given name, state, and configuration.

methods.name: setSessionServerState
methods.description: Changes the state of a session server identified by app name.

methods.name: onSessionServerStateChanged
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from session servers.

methods.name: sendPingEvents
methods.description: Sends ping events to all connected session servers.

methods.name: onAck
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment responses for ping requests.

methods.name: getAppConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection info for a given app.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets logging levels for the session server applications.

methods.name: connectSessionServer
methods.description: Establishes connection to a session server.

methods.name: configureSessionServer
methods.description: Configures a session server with necessary parameters.

methods.name: configurePreloadedSessionServer
methods.description: Configures a preloaded session server for a specific app.

methods.name: changeSessionServerState
methods.description: Requests a state change for a session server.

methods.name: handleSessionServerStateChange
methods.description: Handles internal logic when a session server changes state.

methods.name: shutdownAllSessionServers
methods.description: Shuts down all managed session servers.

methods.name: launchSessionServer
methods.description: Launches a new session server for a given app.

methods.name: preloadSessionServer
methods.description: Preloads a new session server.

methods.name: getPreloadedServer
methods.description: Returns a preloaded session server if available.

methods.name: getServerByAppName
methods.description: Finds a session server by application name.

methods.name: getServerById
methods.description: Finds a session server by server ID.
